items.title: Prato: Batata inglesa cozida + Frango (coxa sem pele assada) + Rúcula
items.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative meal photograph for a nutrition recipe catalog. Primary request: a realistic appetizing serving containing ONLY these named catalog foods (names in Brazilian Portuguese): Batata inglesa cozida; Frango (coxa sem pele assada); R?cula. Atum fresco grelhado is fully cooked grilled tuna: opaque beige-tan flaky muscle chunks with browned edges, no pink or red center, no rare sliced steaks.
